Terms of Service (“Terms”)

The service allows you to apply for third-party provisioned payment related products and services (e.g. services offered by TSYS). TailoredPay does not directly provision products or services itself.

The Company’s responsibilities and scope do not extend into the underwriting, risk analysis, or provision of debit and credit card processing services, which is solely conducted and determined by the credit card processor(s) through whom you apply for merchant services.
